release_notes: Ban 0.0.26: chong mat du lieu va app tat bat ngo — (1) khi dong app luc dang dong bo / xuat Excel / tai tep / dang nhap, moi luong nen duoc dung va cho truoc khi cua so dong, khong con loi 'QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running'; (2) dong app khi dang cho nhap captcha khong con treo 300 giay; (3) cap nhat qua zip: hong o buoc nao cung khoi phuc CA exe lan thu muc _internal, khong de ban cai nua moi nua cu khong mo duoc; (4) loi khi cai ban da tai khong con bi nuot im lang — ghi log va giu trang thai cho lan sau.
